title: Small-plate probe: rotor ⌀ 300 mm (r_out 118.1 mm)
description: DESIGN-SYNTH's named-blocker case (S5): at ⌀ 300 mm C_max ~ 9.8 pF sits below the 16 pF fringe floor, the swing collapses and no gap can dump the trapped charge -- z = 1, does not pump (the bare core is silent too).

z.why: no growing mode (the neutral / silent case)
